correctness.rationale: Exact rooted uniform-angle order-statistic density 2/pi^2 and determinant identity give the full one-dimensional quadrature. Strict sine concavity gives support; quadratic and linear local Taylor geometry gives sharp endpoints and total-variation conditional limits. The interior t=2 level is regular away from three edge maxima with local area normal form 2-s^2+r, giving a negative 8/pi^2 h^(3/2) symmetric cusp. Direct area equivalence and threshold coefficients were independently exercised with seeded Monte Carlo and high-resolution quadrature; these are numerical checks, not proofs.

value.rationale: The area law concerns the first non-parallelogram unit-segment zonotope, a canonical six-edged random convex body; its area is a natural invariant with an exactly equivalent classical random circular-triangle perimeter. Beyond known moments, the full one-dimensional CDF, contrast of quadratic near-collapse and linear near-maximal tails, nontrivial non-C2 interior 3/2 transition at area 2, and explicit conditional shapes distinguish three mathematically motivated regimes. These are usable exact benchmarks, not an arbitrary parameter slice or mere numerical improvement.
